list.title: Notifications
list.intro: What happened that concerns you, newest first. Notifications are kept for 180 days.
list.summary: {unread, plural, =0 {Nothing new} one {# new} other {# new}} · {total, plural, one {# notification} other {# notifications}}

kindHints.ACCOUNT: Decisions about your application and changes to your membership.
kindHints.MY_EVENTS: Events you registered for: confirmation, a place from the waiting list, reminders, changes.
kindHints.ASSOCIATION: Messages the association sends to its members.
kindHints.GUIDELINES: A guideline was added or got a new version.
kindHints.MESSAGES: Chat messages from other members. In the app: the number on the Chat link. By email: at most one message a day saying that unread messages are waiting, without their text.

items.eventChanged: The time or place of “{title}” changed.
items.membershipDirectorApproved: Your department director approved your application ({typeName}). It now waits for the association.
items.newsSentBack: “{title}” was sent back to you for changes.
items.educationSentBack: “{title}” was sent back to you for changes.
items.contentGuidelineVersion: A guideline has a new version: {title}
items.chatMessage: You have a new private message.

preferences.title: Notification preferences
preferences.intro: Choose, for each kind, whether you want it in the app, by email, both or neither.
preferences.digestNote: Email about news, new events, education and guidelines arrives as one summary each morning, and only when there is something new.
preferences.securityNote: Security emails (verifying your address, resetting your password, a sign-in from a new device) are always sent.

unsubscribe.title: Email preferences
unsubscribe.done: Done. You will no longer get emails of this kind:
unsubscribe.missing: This link is incomplete. You can change what you receive in your notification preferences.
unsubscribe.signInNote: You need to sign in to see all your preferences.

admin.title: Messages to members
admin.intro: A message reaches members only after a different administrator approves it.

editor.bodyHint: Plain text. Leave an empty line between paragraphs.
editor.readOnly: This message can no longer be changed.
editor.notYours: Only the person who wrote this message can change or submit it.
editor.submitHint: After you submit it, a different administrator approves it. You can’t approve your own message.

review.ownHint: You wrote this message. A different administrator must approve it.
review.approveHint: Approving sends it at once. This can’t be undone.
